policies.outputs: Only ConfidenceHead final PAE/PDE linear projections and pLDDT/resolved einsums IEEE.
policies.all: All ConfidenceHead matmul IEEE, explicit triangle remains TF32.
policies.geometry_fast: Experimental vectorized direct Euclidean distance with approximate sqrt; recorded separately.
policies.geometry_RNE: Final vectorized direct Euclidean distance with backend sqrt_rn, preserving existing PPU square-root rounding.

scope.baseline: Both native H100 modes and both PPU+FlagGems modes preserved by exact coordinate hash and metric checks; H100 custom triangle separately labeled.
scope.data: Raw tensors/coordinates remain on original servers. Scalar/hash statistics only.
scope.kernel_generality: Any point counts and feature dimensions; broadcast and noncontiguous inputs normalized; block work bounded by feature dimension. No model/input/shape whitelist.
scope.H100_preprocessing_repair: One mini_ism G01 first pass failed in ESM preprocessing. Failed originals retained remotely; first CPU feature batch serialized for rerun and later model stages. All accepted inputs checked against frozen full manifests.
scope.training: No new full-model training claim. Gradient-enabled distance operands fall back to native direct distance; tiny exact forward/gradient control only.

limits: Formal frozen native reference is unchanged. Corrected H100 diagnostics are not native TF32.
Cross-device RMSD intervals are reused only after exact coordinate-hash checks; 11 unresolved intervals cannot be counted as passes.
Original PPU distance already uses a direct FlagGems kernel and ignores compute_mode. API-request labels do not imply a TF32 GEMM on PPU.
Operator probe uses each device own real activation coordinates and own CPU FP64 gold; operand hashes differ across devices.
No new full-model training test or 80%/MFU acceptance. Native gradient fallback verified on small controls only.
RNE fused phase runs separately from base sweep on same per-case physical GPU. Three wall-time repeats cannot certify small whole-model speed changes.
